key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil exploded as OPEC+ suppression failed, HSBC now sees Brent at $90
Iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern; Europe also hiked rates, reinforcing global tightening
ANZ.AX restructuring 3,500 jobs; Queensland credit rating downgrade signals sovereign risk
Housing correction deepens at high end while affordable segment holds; first-home buyers surging
Mining cap-raise wave (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) signals capital stress in junior sector
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c, compounding cost-of-living pressure

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge benefits energy names but weighs on broad miners. Junior miners scrambling for cap raises (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka). Gold-silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) active but 'gold schmould' sentiment persists.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore weakness. Energy names (Santos, Woodside) supported by $90 Brent forecast. Junior miners face dilution risk. Gold miners (Nevada, Regis) may benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX executing 3,500-job cut. Queensland credit downgrade signals regional sovereign risk. RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin compression risk if RBA holds higher for longer. Credit quality concerns in QLD. Net interest margin tailwind from higher rates offset by growth fears.

sectors.trend: Strong positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; HSBC raises Brent to $90 on Hormuz crisis. Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic sacrifice.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), Origin (ORG.AX) benefit from elevated oil/gas. Fuel price rise (+30c) pressures transport and consumer sectors.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached own 'Price Freeze' on staples. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores. Business confidence deteriorating. Tax burden cited as crushing households.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CSL.AX (healthcare) face margin pressure. Consumer discretionary under pressure. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Negative at high end, resilient at affordable end. Housing prices crashing in premium segment; first-home buyers surging. RBA worried about rental inflation. NZ correction still running.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield pressure. Developers (Mirvac, Lendlease) under stress. Affordable housing plays may outperform.

sectors.trend: Selective. HIVE (HIV.AX) scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. Procore AI narrative positive globally.
sectors.implications: AI/HPC names gaining traction but remain speculative. Small-cap volatility elevated amid broad risk-off.

key_themes: Oil surge and Hormuz geopolitical risk driving energy outperformance
Global rate-hike cycle (RBA, ECB) delaying easing, pressuring growth equities
Iron ore structural weakness hitting ASX heavyweight miners
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure
Housing bifurcation: premium crash vs affordable resilience
Superannuation reform debate intensifying (One Nation, macrobusiness)
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and dilution risk
Chinese inflation spike complicating commodity demand outlook

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Hormuz crisis escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Brent $90 threshold; diversify away from oil-importing sectors
Reduce duration in bonds; favour floating-rate and energy equities; monitor RBA rental inflation data
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and energy
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy consumer names
Avoid high-end property REITs; monitor construction and finance sector credit losses
Monitor QLD-linked infrastructure and REIT exposures

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector on oil surge
opportunities.rationale: HSBC $90 Brent forecast on Hormuz crisis; Australia softening gas rules supports domestic gas names

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold on safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk, AUD weakness, and rate uncertainty support gold; Kuniko and Gateway WA exploration active
HIVE scaling BUZZ HPC; Procore AI narrative; ASX runners show momentum in tech

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / heavy mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Chinese inflation complicates demand; cap-raise dilution risk in juniors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end property and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at premium end; RBA rental inflation concern; NZ correction still running

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with domestic-revenue defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; fuel +30c raises input costs; tax burden squeezing consumers

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears and rate-hike expectations persist. Miners and banks remain under pressure. Energy is the lone bright spot. AUD weakness adds import-cost headwinds. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and Hormuz developments.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2026. Iron ore oversupply may correct. Energy transition and AI/HPC offer structural growth. Superannuation reform debate could create policy tailwinds. Key risk: prolonged global rate cycle delaying growth recovery.

Iron ore price floor and Chinese stimulus response
ANZ.AX restructuring progress and cost-out outcomes
watch_list: RBA cash rate and rental CPI
Chinese CPI and property sales data
